key_highlights: ASX set to open higher buoyed by positive global equity cues and a strong rebound across mining and energy sectors.
Accelerating inflation metrics sustain intense pressure on the RBA, keeping cash rate expectations hawkish.
Rising mortgage stress and sharp housing corrections in Brisbane increase asset quality headwinds for domestic lenders.
Flight Centre experiences a significant customer data cyber incident, raising operational and regulatory concerns.

sectors.trend: Upward momentum driven by strong global risk appetite, commodity rebound, and notable gold exploration results.
sectors.implications: Provides near-term earnings and cash flow support for diversified heavyweights and speculative interest in junior gold explorers.

sectors.trend: Crude oil gains support energy producers, while debates over national gas reservation policies persist.
sectors.implications: Short-term margin expansion for major producers, though domestic regulatory and intervention risks remain a medium-term overhang.

sectors.trend: Persistent inflation and higher-for-longer RBA rate expectations exacerbate mortgage stress and regional property market downturns.
sectors.implications: Elevated bad debt provisioning risks and slowing credit growth threaten net interest margins for major banks.

sectors.trend: Retail headwind warnings from prominent industry figures alongside reputational and operational fallout from Flight Centre's cyber breach.
sectors.implications: Compressed consumer disposable income and cyber remediation costs weigh on sector multiples and discretionary spending.

sectors.trend: Commercial and residential construction stress highlighted by developer insolvencies and housing price corrections.
sectors.implications: Depressed transaction volumes and cap-rate expansion pose continuing balance sheet challenges for property developers and REITs.

key_themes: Resource and energy rebound temporarily offsetting domestic macroeconomic drag.
Unanchored inflation sustaining pressure on RBA monetary policy settings.
Household debt stress accelerating real estate market corrections.
Escalating corporate cyber risk impacting market sentiment and compliance costs.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Persistent Domestic Inflation & RBA Policy Tightening
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight rate-sensitive consumer discretionary and leveraged REITs; maintain allocation to quality cash generators.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mortgage Stress & Accelerating Property Price Declines
risk_assessment.mitigation: Trim exposure to lenders with high domestic mortgage concentration and monitor bad debt provisions closely.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Corporate Cyber Attacks & Data Security Failure
risk_assessment.mitigation: Factor elevated governance and compliance risk premia into consumer-facing platforms experiencing data breaches.
Diversify into defensive bullion producers and low-cost export miners less vulnerable to bilateral tariff spikes.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on mining and energy rebound via low-cost producers
opportunities.rationale: Firming global sentiment and crude/metals strength support robust dividend yields and cash flows.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to junior gold exploration and restart assets
opportunities.rationale: High-grade intercepts and mine restarts offer attractive valuation upside amidst safe-haven demand.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to retail consumer discretionary names
defensive_moves.rationale: Sticky inflation, rising mortgage stress, and recession warnings severely depress discretionary spend.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight high-multiple major bank equities facing housing headwinds
defensive_moves.rationale: Mortgage stress and property corrections in eastern capitals threaten loan book quality and net interest margins.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX performance with resources driving initial gains, tempered by sticky inflation prints and RBA rate overhang.
market_outlook.long_term: Valuation reset likely across domestic cyclicals as persistent interest rate pressures weigh on consumer and residential sectors.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and monetary policy minutes
China economic recovery metrics and iron ore demand indicators
Retail sales figures and mortgage arrears disclosures
watch_list: Iron ore 62% Fe CFR Qingdao benchmark
